verdict.stance: Overweight / OTP-Owned Uzbek Transformation & Rising Star Outlook (BB Pos / BB- Pos)
verdict.summary: Ipoteka Bank (controlled by Hungary's OTP Group) has completed post-privatization restructuring, delivering 9M26 net profit of ~UZS 1.93trn (+56% YoY), assets of UZS 57.9trn (+16% YoY), Total CAR of 21.1%, and Stage 3 NPLs falling to 3.2%. Both Fitch (Sep-26, BB Positive) and S&P (BB- Positive) revised outlooks to Positive.

positives: OTP Group strategic control, risk management overhaul, and capital support underpin Fitch/S&P Positive outlooks.
Strong capitalization (CAR 21.1%, Tier 1 17.6%) and 9M26 earnings surge (+56% YoY to ~$151m+).
Clean refinancing of Nov-25 Eurobond into $300m 6.45% Oct-30 notes (XS3200121716) eliminates near-term USD wall.
negatives: Legacy state-directed corporate portfolio cleanup still progressing despite NPL drop to 3.2%.
Uzbekistan banking sector high dollarization and UZS depreciation exposure.
Apr-27 UZS 1.37trn (~$108m) local-currency Eurobond maturity requires domestic/Vienna rollover.
